Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the query by treating “the city the winner is from” as Andy Roddick’s birthplace (Omaha) instead of the city he is from/associated with (Austin), then prematurely concluding “there is no year.” This wrong framing derailed the solution and was later compounded by confusing “capital” with “capitol,” citing 1888 (capitol building completion) instead of 1839 (when Austin became the capital of Texas).
